name: web-dark-editorial-serif-earbuds-store-bento-hero
title: Dark Serif Earbuds Store Bento Hero
whatItIs: A black rounded page on a periwinkle backdrop with a floating pill nav, a large hero tile of black earbuds on a wireless charger with a white serif headline 'TRUE WIRLESS EARBUDS' and two buttons, side product cards for earbuds and a watch with frosted captions, and text tiles for the brand story.
whatItMeans: A serif on black feels luxurious and editorial, and the bento tiles present products like gallery pieces.
techniques: Large serif caps headline on a dark photo
Bento of a big hero tile and smaller product tiles
Frosted caption panels over product images
Rounded notch in tiles for the text card
Pill nav with search and avatar

vocabulary.definition: A hero built from a large tile beside smaller tiles.
A blurred translucent panel carrying a product label.
A tile with a cut-out for an adjoining tile.
